doctrine: Learn faster without weakening integrity. Forward-only CLV is the primary promotion evidence when free historical closes are unavailable. PAPER and BLOCKED are distinct: PAPER means valid evidence that is insufficient or underperforming; BLOCKED means contaminated evidence that is excluded from the evidence set.

activation.rule: V2 activates only when this policy is selected by the manifest on evidence_ref. Feature-branch commits never activate an evidence clock.
activation.clock_start: First valid evidence row captured after the active manifest and policy are present on refs/heads/main and bound to the active policy SHA256.

non_retroactive.rule: Never reinterpret evidence captured before V2 activation under V2.
non_retroactive.historical_evidence: May be retained as context or adverse prior evidence, but never substituted for V2 forward evidence. Adverse historical evidence is not erased by the new policy.

PAPER.meaning: Valid forward evidence is collected, but the lane is not approved for real-money betting or has been demoted for performance/risk reasons.

PROBATION.meaning: Small real-money evidence collection after the fixed 50-bet checkpoint only.

OFFICIAL.meaning: Promotion requirements have been met at a fixed checkpoint and every warning is cleared or explicitly signed off.

BLOCKED.meaning: Integrity failure or contaminated evidence. A BLOCKED row is excluded from CLV, ROI, checkpoint counts, and promotion decisions.

close.missing_close_policy: Exclude the row from CLV calculation but keep it in the checkpoint denominator and close-coverage denominator.

clv_inference.metric: probability-point CLV on the same non-push basis used at entry

checkpoints.graded_count_definition: All valid non-BLOCKED bets under the current evidence clock, including rows missing a valid close.

checkpoint_100.rule: Remain PROBATION unless a kill rule fires. Do not promote OFFICIAL at 100 under V2.

checkpoint_150.warnings_requirement: Every warning must be CLEARED or SIGNED_OFF before OFFICIAL.

kill_and_demotion_rules.blocked_immediately_if: Any hard_integrity_blocks condition is true. Contaminated rows are excluded rather than treated as losses or PAPER evidence.

historical_adverse_evidence.rule: A lane with genuine historical evidence showing it lost to closing lines starts V2 in PAPER with HISTORICAL_ADVERSE_EVIDENCE warning. V2 does not erase or relabel the old result.
historical_adverse_evidence.warning_clears_only_if: The lane independently satisfies V2 forward evidence requirements under a new evidence clock.

official_warning_signoff.rule: A warning that is merely logged is not sufficient for OFFICIAL.
